#include "KnapsackPlanner.h"
#include <algorithm>
bool KnapsackPlanner_plan(const std::vector<int>& weights, const std::vector<int>& values, int capacity, int& maxValue, std::vector<int>& selectedIndices) { selectedIndices.clear(); maxValue = 0; if (capacity < 0 || weights.size() != values.size()) { return false; } for (size_t i = 0; i < weights.size(); ++i) { if (weights[i] < 0 || values[i] < 0) { return false; } } const int n = static_cast<int>(weights.size()); std::vector<std::vector<int>> dp(n + 1, std::vector<int>(capacity + 1, 0)); for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) { for (int w = 0; w <= capacity; ++w) { dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w]; if (weights[i - 1] <= w) { int candidate = dp[i - 1][w - weights[i - 1]] + values[i - 1]; if (candidate > dp[i][w]) { dp[i][w] = candidate; } } } } maxValue = dp[n][capacity]; int remaining = capacity; for (int i = n; i >= 1; --i) { if (dp[i][remaining] != dp[i - 1][remaining]) { selectedIndices.push_back(i - 1); remaining -= weights[i - 1]; } } std::reverse(selectedIndices.begin(), selectedIndices.end()); return true; }
